An '''Esoomian''' worked for [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's criminal empire]]. The violent henchman could sometimes be found on [[Khetanna/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's sail barge]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The [[Esoomian/Legends|Esoomian]] used a ball-and-chain weapon to attack his enemies. He had orange skin and green eyes.
